name: web-search
description: Search the web for current information on a topic. Returns a list of relevant results with titles, snippets, and URLs.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 10 (default 5)

name: fetch-and-summarize
description: Fetch a web page by URL and return the first N characters of its text content. Useful for reading articles, documentation, or any publicly accessible page.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of page text to return, from 100 to 50000 (default 5000)

name: read-file
description: Read the contents of a file from the workspace. Supports text files such as .txt, .json, .csv, .md, and code files.

path.description: Relative path to the file within the workspace

encoding.description: How to decode the file: utf-8 (default) or base64

name: write-file
description: Write content to a file in the workspace. Creates parent directories if they don't exist.

path.description: Relative path to the file within the workspace

name: db-query
description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the configured PostgreSQL database. Only SELECT statements are allowed.

name: calculator
description: Evaluate a mathematical expression. Supports arithmetic, exponents, parentheses, and common math functions (sqrt, abs, ceil, floor, round, min, max, log, sin, cos, tan, PI, E).

expression.description: A mathematical expression to evaluate, e.g. '(12 * 8) + sqrt(144)'
